product_overview: Burger Page is a multi-tenant web application for artisanal burger restaurants, combining a public customer storefront with an administrative backoffice. Customers can browse and order from a restaurant menu, while administrators manage orders, menu items, inventory, and tenant restaurants.
core_goals: Browse restaurant menus by category on the public storefront
Customize burger items and manage a cart before checkout
Place an order with customer and delivery details
Track and advance order status in the restaurant backoffice
Create and maintain menu products and availability
Monitor and update inventory stock levels
Manage tenant restaurants as a super administrator

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Authorized users can sign in through the admin gateway and enter the appropriate backoffice area based on their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Enter username and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See redirect to the restaurant admin dashboard for a restaurant administrator
Navigate to /admin -> Enter username and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See redirect to the restaurant registry for a super administrator
Navigate to /admin -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an error notification

features.name: Public Storefront Catalog and Cart
features.description: Customers can browse the public restaurant storefront, filter products by category, customize items, and manage items in the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /rosto -> Browse the menu catalog -> Filter products by category -> Select an item to view its details -> Choose available additions -> Add the item to the cart -> Open the cart and review selected items
Navigate to /rosto -> Browse the menu catalog -> Select an item to view its details -> Choose available additions -> Add the item to the cart -> Open the cart and review selected items

features.name: Order Placement
features.description: Customers can proceed from the cart to checkout, provide delivery details, choose a payment method, and submit an order.
user_flows: Navigate to /rosto -> Open the cart and review items -> Proceed to checkout -> Fill in customer name, phone, and delivery address -> Select a payment method -> Submit the order -> See confirmation of order placement

features.name: Orders Kanban Management
features.description: Restaurant administrators can view orders by status and move them through the preparation lifecycle or cancel them.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/orders -> View orders grouped by status -> Advance an order through preparation stages -> See the order move across status columns
Navigate to /admin/orders -> View orders grouped by status -> Cancel an order -> See the order removed from the active workflow

features.name: Menu and Product Management
features.description: Restaurant administrators can create, edit, update availability, and remove menu products.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/menu -> Start adding a new product -> Enter the product name, price, category, and description -> Set product availability -> Save the product -> See the product appear in the catalog
Navigate to /admin/menu -> Select an existing product -> Update product details or availability -> Save the changes -> See the updated product information reflected in the menu
Navigate to /admin/menu -> Select an existing product -> Delete the product -> See the product removed from the list

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Restaurant administrators can review stock, add inventory items, and adjust quantities.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/inventory -> View the current inventory list -> Add a new inventory item -> Enter quantity and unit -> Save the item -> See it appear in inventory
Navigate to /admin/inventory -> View the current inventory list -> Select an inventory item -> Adjust its stock level -> Save the change -> See the updated quantity

features.name: Superadmin Restaurant Management
features.description: Super administrators can view tenant restaurants, create new restaurants, and toggle whether a restaurant is active.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/restaurants -> View the list of tenant restaurants -> Create a new restaurant -> Enter the restaurant name and slug -> Save the restaurant -> See the new tenant added to the registry
Navigate to /admin/restaurants -> View the list of tenant restaurants -> Select a restaurant -> Toggle its active status -> See the restaurant status updated
